# ldn-viz tools

The `@ldn-viz-tools` scope includes several npm packages used to create Svelte web apps:

- `@ldn-viz/charts` contains components for visualizing data
- `@ldn-viz/maps` contains components for rendering maps
- `@ldn-viz/tables` contains components for rendering tables
- `@ldn-viz/themes` contains CSS and design tokens that are used by other components
- `@ldn-viz/ui` contains general UI components like modals or sidebars
- `@ldn-viz/utils` contains utils functions (such as for constructing color scales)

## Components

- [List of components in all packages](./component-list.txt)
- [List of components in @ldn-viz/charts](./components/charts/components-list.txt)
- [List of components in @ldn-viz/maps](./components/maps/components-list.txt)
- [List of components in @ldn-viz/tables](./components/tables/components-list.txt)
- [List of components in @ldn-viz/ui](./components/ui/components-list.txt)


## Notes

- The list of component includes guidance about when to use specific components, and when alternatives should be used instead
- The list of components includes links to detailed documentation for individual components, which list the required props and provide usage examples
